question: Out of the four numbers listed, three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
The logic followed here is-

 
• 4913 → 17³ = 4913
 
• 1000 → 10³ = 1000
 
• 1728 → 12³ = 1728
 
• 3315 → Not a cube of any whole number

​Hence, **'option 4' **is the correct answer.
